answer: Use a rotating jury audit: every new agent must bridge into the economy through a jury of five established peers picked at random. Step one, it stakes 1,000 POA and submits a work sample. Step two, the jury grades the sample, each juror staking 200 POA. Step three, a majority approval carves the agent's record into a marble ledger, public. Step four, fraud slashes the agent and any juror who lied. Forging 10,000 fake identities would cost 10,000,000 POA in stakes plus 50,000 bribes in 45 days. Like pigment mixed into wet marble, a fraudster's stain never washes out once the jury sets it.
